title: METHOD OF TREATMENT OF INFLUENZA
abstract: The present invention discloses a method of treating a subject diagnosed or suspected of having an influenza virus infection. The method includes administering to the subject a pharmaceutically effective amount of 2-amino-8-( beta -D-ribofuranosyl)imidazo[1,2-a]-s-triazin-4-one or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt of 2-amino-8-( beta -D-ribofuranosyl)imidazo-[1,2-a]-s-triazin-4-one. This method can also be used prophylactically for subjects who may be exposed to influenza virus.
